annotations.title: Rename, describe or move a category or tag

description: Changes one category or tag; only the fields you send change. Take the id from read-terms. Renaming keeps the slug, so the address still works, and a name already taken in that taxonomy is refused. `description` replaces what is there: read it first, and an empty string clears it. `parent` moves a category, and 0 moves it to the top level. ⛔ It can’t delete, merge or change a slug. Limited to 30 term writes an hour for each connection.

description.description: The new description. Replaces the current one; an empty string clears it. Only basic inline HTML survives (a, em, strong, code); WordPress removes the rest. Scripts and event handlers are refused.

name.description: The new name, in plain text.

parent.description: The new parent category’s id, 0 for the top level. Categories only.

slug.description: ⛔ Always refused: a slug is the term’s address and nothing would redirect the old one. Declared so the refusal reaches you rather than the value vanishing.

name: agentimus-update-term

note.description: Not empty when WordPress changed the description as it saved. Tell the owner if that matters.
